verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe running evals from code and integrating them into CI/CD to catch regressions (e.g., 'Run evals on every pull request' and Experiments 'integrate into CI/CD to catch regressions before they reach production'), and the Eval() SDK API plus CLI support scripted eval runs. However, there's no concrete evidence of built-in deployment gating (e.g., pass/fail thresholds blocking merges) beyond generic CI integration claims, and community feedback notes sparse documentation/integration limitations.
